caveats.statement: 性别代码在gender表中可能以不同大小写或缩写出现,直接等值匹配可能漏掉部分英雄
属性名称在attribute表中大小写不一致(如'durability'与'Durability'),直接匹配会漏数据
颜色值'No Colour'表示无眼睛颜色,与NULL不同,需用等值匹配而非IS NULL
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour = 'No Colour';

caveats.statement: 部分英雄可能没有对应的hero_attribute记录,计算属性极值时会遗漏这些英雄
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id WHERE ha.hero_id IS NULL;

caveats.statement: 部分英雄可能没有对应的hero_power记录,统计超能力时会遗漏这些英雄
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id WHERE hp.hero_id IS NULL;

caveats.statement: height_cm或weight_kg可能为NULL,计算平均值或差值时会影响结果
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE height_cm IS NULL OR weight_kg IS NULL;

caveats.statement: alignment表中可能包含'Neutral'等中间阵营,仅用'Bad'筛选反派会漏掉部分非正派英雄
